Finding the best headset for GTA 6 means working out what you want from your experience, and which audio features the game itself will actually be asking of your tech. We now know GTA 6 will be making the most of Tempest 3D Audio on PS5 and Dolby Atmos on Xbox, and while rumors swirl around the engine's reconstructive audio, this could well be the launchpad for an audio upgrade. The best gaming headsets will take full advantage of each console's spatial audio capabilities while adding extra features like simultaneous 2.4GHz and Bluetooth (for running your own soundtrack over Leonida), ANC, and fine-tuned EQ settings. Whether you're leaving the TV speakers behind for the first time or retiring an aging, failing set of cups, it's worth remembering you don't need to jump to the top of the price range to find one of the best headsets for GTA 6. We've been ears-on with the biggest releases from Razer, Logitech, SteelSeries, Turtle Beach, Corsair, and more over the six years of current-gen consoles. That means hunting down the best PS5 headsets and best Xbox Series X headsets on the daily, and finding the best value among them. You'll find all the best headsets we recommend for GTA 6 specifically just below. The best headset for GTA 6 overall SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Wireless Just to clear something up straight out the gate. The SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Wireless is no longer at the top of our top headset recommendation list. That's because the successor, the Nova Pro Omni , has secured the top spot with its Hi-Res audio. That full 96kHz response is only available on PC , though, which means GTA 6 players on consoles won't be getting their money's worth. The Pro Wireless still packs some of the best audio we've heard so far (and is fully Tempest-compatible) with hot-swappable batteries, ANC, and a quick-swap hub. PS5 players can get away with a slightly lower price on the PlayStation model ( $289.99 at Amazon ), while Xbox players are looking at $299.99 at Amazon here. That full 96kHz response is only available on PC , though, which means GTA 6 players on consoles won't be getting their money's worth. Pros Incredible SteelSeries audio quality Awesome DAC/hub with great options Superb build and design Excellent connectivity options Ingenius battery solution Cons One of the most expensive premium gaming headsets going The SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Wireless is our top recommendation for those upgrading their gaming headset for GTA 6. You're getting the bold, spacious, punchy audio we've been celebrating for years here, with a particularly strong bass response for those engine revs, a super clear mid-range for that soundtrack, and a ton of space in the upper ranges for more directional awareness. This is the audio we've been comparing the best PS5 headsets against for years, sitting alongside features we're yet to see replicated successfully across the market. ANC keeps the rest of the world firmly away from your Leonida adventures, while hot-swappable batteries mean you'll never need to charge up before jumping into the action. Is the newer SteelSeries Arctis Nova Pro Omni our first shout in general? Yes, it boosts audio slightly - but mostly for PC players with its Hi-Res certification. It adds an extra USB port on the charging / EQ hub it carries over from the original, and improves the microphone clarity to boot. Considering it's often a whole $100 more than the Pro Wireless, and its main feature upgrade is locked behind a PC, though, the best headset for GTA 6 remains old faithful. More of the best headsets for GTA 6 on PS5 Best budget Turtle Beach Atlas 200 for PS5 Just looking to upgrade from TV speakers ahead of GTA 6? The Turtle Beach Atlas 200 is our go-to budget headset for PS5. This wired connection keeps the price low but also removes the need for charging altogether. Don't let that lower price tag put you off the audio between these cups either. Times have moved on since the old days of cheap Turtle Beach headsets - we were impressed with the power and clarity of PS5 gameplay through these cans. As a fully licensed accessory, the Atlas 200 is also equipped for PlayStation's Tempest 3D engine as well.
